phase_name: Guardian Web v4 — visual hardening + protected financial launch

last_physical_finding.conclusion: On this Redmi/Android 16, accessibility tree still exposed no usable root/host; screenshot/OCR works but private detection failed and old web rows contaminated the screen. Bank Mode disableSelf worked.

implemented_in_0_1_25: Visual OCR uses a stricter host gate: single-word noise and implausible long TLD OCR artifacts are rejected while tree URL values keep the general sanitizer
Current Chromium incognito redesign text is recognized in pt-BR and English, including 'Agora você pode navegar com privacidade' contextual evidence
Visual host OCR crop reduced from 22% to 16% to avoid page-body false positives; private visual probe expanded from 62% to 90% of the display
Guardian Web UI adds Iniciar teste limpo to clear only web history/telemetry and reset in-memory host/private state in deterministic queue order
FinancialAppCatalog separates financial apps from the broader PRIVATE classifier
Inter Empresas br.com.Inter.CDPro and Inter br.com.intermedium are confirmed financial packages
PrivacyClassifier v3 delegates financial apps to FinancialAppCatalog so financial usage is stored as PRIVATE
Guardian Web lists installed financial launcher apps and offers Abrir com proteção
Protected launch calls disableSelf, waits for AccessibilityManager=false and secure setting=false, then starts the financial app
UsageStats adds a best-effort automatic financial foreground failsafe that disables Guardian Web when a recognized financial app is opened directly
Automatic failsafe never replaces protected launch because foreground detection necessarily happens after the bank process starts
No database migration, no new network permission, no bank/account/transaction content persistence
next_task: Upload the small 0.1.25 Actions-#66 parser patch. Require all 49+ unit tests and APK build/contract/signing to pass, then install the resulting 0.1.25 and run the clean normal/incognito + protected Inter test already defined.
